topics.title: Anything on the Robinhood Chain Deserves a Look
topics.hook_summary: One of the most magnificent chains out there right now is the Robinhood chain: Cash Cat already surpassed Base in volume, What If is within reach of flagship, and a Robinhood app spot listing takes these memes beyond a billion.
topics.why_it_works: Project hype, priority 1 for Mike's shorts. Data-anchored scroll-stops (surpassed Base in volume, 7M cap, another 5x, 7 billion = 1000x) plus an outsized prediction with a reason. Scattered across three separate points of the stream, classic scatter-gather.

peak_beats.line: who the hell knows how much it can go, it'll go beyond a billion
seven billion would be like a thousand X, how far could it go

topics.title: Stick Through the Pain and Win
topics.hook_summary: This is the pain, man; but if you're in it and you haven't checked out like everybody else, you're gonna be sitting pretty, and I'll sell to the people who thought they were buying the bottom, FOMOing in because prices are going nuts.
topics.why_it_works: Philosophical / inspiring (priority 2) with a tribal payoff aimed at the October buy-back crowd. Delivery reads live: the Pacino 'here come the pain' bit, doubling ('the pain man, the pain'), and the sell-to-FOMO punchline. Evergreen, not tied to a data print.

peak_beats.line: I'll sell to the people who thought they were going to buy back in at the bottom, FOMOing in because prices are going nuts
if you're in it man, if you can stick through this and you haven't checked out like everybody else, in the long run you gotta be making a lot of money, you're gonna be sitting pretty

topics.title: This Much Kaspa Hate Signals a Change
topics.hook_summary: A year ago I would hardly get any negative comments about Kaspa, now it's like three out of ten on my videos, and when a project gets that much hate, something's got to change really soon; things are going to start flying soon.
topics.why_it_works: Kaspa conviction wearing a contrarian coat: capitulation-as-signal, not a price readout. Data-anchored (3 in 10 comments), self-contained, gives the viewer a side to pick against the haters.

peak_beats.line: things are going to start flying soon... when a project gets that much hate, it's like something's got to change really soon

topics.title: Tariff Season Ended My Four-Year Cycle Belief
topics.hook_summary: I had some really good hopes back when I was a four-year cycle zombie, a year and three or four months ago; tariff season is what really changed me, we went below the 50-week SMA in the post-halving year and I realized: no, that's not happening.
topics.why_it_works: Personal conviction story (top-performing type 2) plus the tribal label. Past-tense conversion is persona-canon ('I shed my four-year cycle belief'), framed as Mike seeing reality before the zombies did, never as a mistake. Opens on the relatable 'will Kaspa be a dollar' question.

peak_beats.line: back when I was a four-year cycle zombie... because tariff season is what really changed me

topics.title: Kraken Is Delisting Housecoin, I'm Still Holding
topics.hook_summary: We got an email today, Kraken is gonna delist Housecoin and Ghibli; Housecoin is still in the game, still one of my favorite plays, still making content non-stop, and I'm definitely still holding a lot of it, hopefully it does a 1000x from here.
topics.why_it_works: Project conviction despite bad news: the delisting is only the setup, the clip is the hold. Housecoin is a named Mike-championed play, fresh news this stream, and it ends on a concrete conviction number.

peak_beats.line: definitely still holding a lot of Housecoin, I love it, hopefully it's gonna do like a thousand X man from where it is right now, right

clips.title: Once This Happens, Housecoin Goes 1,000x.

segments.note: News hook: 'we got an email today, Kraken is gonna delist... Ghibli and Housecoin are among them', plus the community question 'should I just dump Housecoin, is it safe?'

The answer: 'Housecoin is still in the game, I still consider it one of my favorite plays, still making content non-stop, still got other centralized exchanges, which is good for a meme in a bear market, right?'
Conviction close: 'again, definitely still holding a lot of Housecoin, I love it, hopefully it's gonna do like a 1000x from where it is right now, right? Yeah.'

clips.rationale: Question -> answer -> conviction, chronological. Cutting 213.0-233.8 removes the rambly whose-decision-was-it speculation; the join reads 'is it safe? / Housecoin is still in the game'. Seg1 out and seg2 in are flush cuts 0.08s from the neighboring word (no pause exists; flagged); seg3 boundaries sit in real pauses (1.0s and 4.9s). Whisper's 'a thousand eggs' at 365.0 is 'a thousand X'; captions must correct. 'cracking' = Kraken.
